column3: False positive: digits in the random W3C traceId of problem+json error responses (e.g. 401 from the Admin API) look like a card number. No personal data is returned.
Informational. Admin API and page responses are Cache-Control: no-store (RFC 6749 §5.1 for tokens); ZAP asks to re-examine them, nothing to change.
Informational. Static assets (CSS, icons) are cacheable on purpose; protocol responses and pages are no-store.
Informational. The user agent fuzzer found no difference in responses.
Informational. 4xx responses to the scanner's malformed or unauthenticated requests are expected.
Informational. The ReturnUrl hidden field echoes the request's return URL, HTML-encoded by Razor; it is only followed when it is a local URL (open redirect check).
Informational. ZAP identified the session cookie; it is __Host- prefixed, Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax.

Informational. The token in the URL is the one-time link from a verification or password reset email. Pages are no-store with Referrer-Policy: no-referrer, and GET only shows a confirmation form; the token is used by the POST.
